facts.fact: VOA Somali reports SIPS was formally launched in Mogadishu on 22 January 2025, built jointly by the Central Bank of Somalia and private banks, linking payments across banks.

systems.owner: Central Bank of Somalia with private banks

SOM.note: Document states no consumer protection rules or complaints body.
Document states nothing on cross-border payments.
Government salary payments through SIPS are described only as a possible use, not delivered.

facts.fact: VOA Somali reports SIPS, launched 22 January 2025, links payments across different banks and mobile money/wallet services so customers can pay across providers.
VOA Somali reports the Central Bank and private banks launched SIPS on 22 January 2025, a national system connecting bank payments and mobile money wallets.

systems.owner: Central Bank of Somalia with private banks

SOM.note: Tax collection via SIPS is described only as a possible benefit, not in service.
